__comment: Stand-in for Forge's forge:item/bucket_drip, the parent of Tinkers' 70 filled buckets. 'fluid' is the mask that shapes the fluid to the inside of the bucket; Forge shipped its own PNG, so this uses Tinkers' equivalent contents mask (the same one the potion bucket layers under its bucket sprite). Forge's mask also draws a drip on the lip, which this one lacks.
